Meta Resists State AGs in Social Media Addiction Lawsuit Trial

Meta Platforms is pushing back against a coalition of state attorneys general in a lawsuit alleging the company's social media platforms cause addiction and harm to young users. The trials have now begun, with Meta disputing the claims made by the attorneys general. The core of the legal battle centers on whether Meta's platforms are designed in ways that foster addiction and negatively impact adolescent mental health. The company is actively defending its practices as the legal proceedings commence.
